rules.text: You can return items within 30 days of purchase with a receipt for a full refund.
rules.quote: Everything you buy at Ollie's is covered by our 30-day no hard time guarantee. If for any reason you are not completely satisfied with your purchase - please return it within 30 days for a full refund. But ya gotta have your receipt!

rules.text: Items purchased between now and December 31st can be returned by January 31st for a full refund with a sales receipt.
rules.quote: If not completely satisfied with your purchase made between Now and December 31st, return it by January 31st for a full refund(with sales receipt).
